label: Cue Sheet+
description:
Enhanced Garmin-style Course Points & Cue Sheet extension for Hammerhead Karoo 3.

• Full-Page View: 5-row high-contrast list of upcoming Waypoints, POIs, Climbs, and Finish with manual ▲/▼ scrolling.
• Interactive Detail Card: Tap any row to inspect its elevation sparkline profile, distance to go, ascent/descent, and optional padlock lock.
• Single-Field Data View: Compact Next Waypoint cell (1-column or wide) with category badge, distance, and live ETA.
• Terrain & VAM ETA Engine: Auto-detects Road, Gravel, or MTB profile and adapts rolling flat pace and climbing VAM.
• Smart Route Tools: Climb summit integration, nearby account POIs, multi-lap circuit deduplication, Day/Night themes, and multilingual UI (EN/ES/PT/FR/IT/DE).
releaseNotes: v1.0.4: Disabled touch overlays in preview mode so the field can be easily replaced/removed in the Data Page editor; added adaptive half-page (2-3 rows) and compact single-cell rendering for shared Data Pages; removed Live Demo Mode setting.
